rationale: The Latin anchors *ducere*, *producere*, *educere*, and especially the biblical phrase *eduxi te de terra* ("I led/brought you out of the land") point to a concrete sense of leading or drawing something away from a place. Among the candidates, withdraw.v.01 ("pull back or move away or backward") best captures this physical, directional movement, though remove.v.01 is also competitive; the "withdraw" framing aligns well with the OE *a-lǽdan* ("to lead away/out") in the Psalms contexts cited.
